page.content:
Remote planet of the First Foundation and the Vault.

How Terminus connects

  • Faction: First Foundation — The First Foundation is planted on Terminus.
  • Location: Time Vault — The Time Vault stands on Terminus.
  • Event: First Crisis — The First Crisis breaks on Terminus.

What is Terminus?

Terminus is the resource-poor world at the Galaxy's edge where Seldon plants the Encyclopedia and the Time Vault that speaks at each crisis.

Key threads lead to First Foundation, Time Vault and First Crisis.
